# mxroute_reseller_user (Data Source)

Read one reseller-owned user. Passwords are never returned. The effective quota is reported as returned, never derived from package settings. Requires a plain reseller provider; impersonation aliases are rejected before any request.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mxroute_reseller_user" "customer" {
  username = "customer1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) Exact existing username.

### Read-Only

- `domain` (String) Primary domain.
- `email` (String) Contact email.
- `package` (String) Assigned package.
- `quota_mb` (String) Effective disk quota in MB, or `unlimited`.
- `quota_used_mb` (Number) Volatile disk usage in MB.
- `suspended` (Boolean) Suspension state.
